name: hero
whatItDemonstrates: A labeled determinate progress bar ('Export data') whose value animates from 20 toward 100 through simulated random increments, with Progress.Value self-rendering the numeric percentage and the Indicator's width tracking the value.
stateManaged: controlled — useState(20) wrapping Progress.Root's `value`, updated by a 1s setInterval simulation that adds up to 25 (clamped at 100) and is cleared on unmount
nonTrivialInteractions: interval-driven simulated progress updates: every 1000ms the value rises by a random 0-25 amount, rounded and clamped to max 100
Progress.Value renders the numeric value with no children passed to it
Indicator width tracks the value with a 500ms width transition; Track clips it via overflow hidden
Track contains Indicator as its child (nesting matches the page's Anatomy snippet)
